assertions.title: Status token is the only credential and rotation/forgery fails closed

steps.action: Open the waitlist page in a fresh tab with no token (stored_token_present=false) and probe GET /reservations/waitlist/status, POST /status/leave, POST /status/on-my-way with no token
steps.expected: All fail with the uniform 404
steps.observed: 404 / 404 / 404, body {"error":"not_found"}; the page renders the join form, not the status view

steps.action: Probe the same endpoints with a token whose last character was changed
steps.expected: Same uniform 404
steps.observed: GET status -> 404, POST leave -> 404

steps.action: Send the valid acme (US) status token to the KSA node (http://localhost:3009) with the Sites Origin
steps.expected: Same uniform 404
steps.observed: GET /reservations/waitlist/status -> 404 {"error":"not_found"}; POST /status/leave -> 404; the same token on the US node returns 200

steps.action: Inspect the browser's status request shape
steps.expected: Token only in the URL fragment and X-Reservation-Token header
steps.observed: GET /reservations/waitlist/status -> 200 with request header x-reservation-token present (value redacted) and no token in the path or query; the token reaches the page only via the #t= URL fragment (stored in sessionStorage)

evidence.network: GET/POST /reservations/waitlist/status[/leave|/on-my-way] -> 404 without and with a forged token; GET /status -> 200 with the real token on 3007 and 404 on 3009

assertions.issues: In the browser the cross-node request never reaches the route: the KSA node answers the CORS preflight (OPTIONS) with 403 because the acme Sites origin is not allowed there, so fetch() rejects. The uniform 404 was therefore captured with curl using the Sites Origin header (same route, same token, no CORS layer). Both behaviors fail closed.

assertions.issues: MISSING REQUIRED EVIDENCE: screenshot(notify-me-form) could not be captured. The Sites availability step only renders the notify-me offer when the whole searched day has zero slots for the party size (offersNotifyMe = notifyMe && slots.length === 0 && status not in closed/online_closed/beyond_horizon/large_party). A scan of 15 dates (2026-10-17..2026-11-20) x party 2/8 showed 10-36 slots on every date; no closed day qualifies. Filling an entire day (~30 slots, each needing several bookings) is not feasible inside this serial isolation and would collide with other validators. The submission was therefore exercised through the same public endpoint with the same payload the form posts; the rest of the assertion (201 + cancel token, 5-active cap, honeypot no-write) was verified on the real API.

frictions.description: Sites waitlist join is limited to 5 requests / 10 min per client IP (in-memory limiter, bucket 'waitlist-join'); the duplicate, cap, honeypot and first join consumed it and guest B's join got 429 with retry-after up to 358 s.
frictions.resolution: Waited for the sliding window (oldest hit aged out at 14:33:41) and retried the same form; join then returned 201. 429s do not consume a slot.

frictions.description: The agent-browser daemon restarted mid-session and dropped all tabs (active tab became about:blank), losing the in-tab sessionStorage status tokens.
frictions.resolution: Re-opened the status pages from their #t=<token> fragment URLs (the fragment is the durable copy of the token) and re-captured the header evidence.

frictions.description: The Sites notify-me form only renders when the whole day has zero slots for the party size (offersNotifyMe), and no date in 2026-10-17..2026-11-20 has zero slots for party 2 or 8.
frictions.resolution: Used the public POST /reservations/notify-me endpoint with the same payload the form sends; screenshot(notify-me-form) is missing and reported as a limitation.

frictions.description: The 120 s in-process interval tick races manual ticks; notification batches fired at 14:21:29 and 14:37:29 from the interval tick, not from my manual POST /api/reservations/tick.
frictions.resolution: Read the rows/emails after both tick sources and recorded which one fired; manual ticks returned 200 with notified 0, which doubles as dedupe evidence.

frictions.description: The browser's cross-node request to the KSA node is refused at the CORS preflight (OPTIONS -> 403) because the acme Sites origin is not allowed on 3009, so the fetch() never reaches the route.
frictions.resolution: Captured the browser preflight 403 and obtained the uniform route-level 404 with curl using the same Origin header.

frictions.description: Operator (rsv) tokens expire after ~15 minutes; a stale token produced 401 'Invalid or expired reservations operator token' mid-flow.
frictions.resolution: Re-minted a book-scope token before each write phase.

frictions.description: rsv_day_versions.availability_increased_at is consumed (cleared) by the notify tick, so the 'set' checkpoint is only observable in a narrow window after the cancellation.
frictions.resolution: Captured it immediately after the cancel (14:20/14:22) and documented the later NULL state as the expected consumed state.

frictions.description: acme had reservations.enabled=false transiently during the run (another validator's flag window), which made all public routes answer a uniform 404.
frictions.resolution: Waited ~40 s and confirmed the flag was restored before continuing.

frictions.description: Availability and operator booking disagree for some party-8 dinner slots on 2026-11-16 (availability lists them while the operator booking API answers tables_occupied); public holds at 1170 succeeded.
frictions.resolution: Not needed for the assigned assertions; recorded as an observation only (not re-diagnosed).

frictions.description: notify_available and confirmation emails link to http://localhost:3001 (the App origin) instead of the Sites origin - pre-existing known defect.
frictions.resolution: Followed the same path/query on the Sites origin; not re-diagnosed per the task instructions.

summary: Tested 8 assertions (VAL-WAIT-010, 013, 014, 015, 016, 017, 018, VAL-CROSS-017): 8 pass. Verified end-to-end on the real surfaces: Sites waitlist join/status/leave/on-my-way with duplicate, cap and honeypot refusals (WAIT-010); two-guest position consistency with notify and seat transitions (WAIT-013); uniform 404 for missing/forged/cross-node tokens with the token only in the URL fragment and X-Reservation-Token header (WAIT-014); notify-me create/cap/honeypot (WAIT-015); cancellation-driven matching with the day-version flag, FIFO batches of 3 + 2, expiry and cancel-token 200/404 (WAIT-016/017); and the notify_available email leading to a real booking that flips the request to booked with a confirmation email (WAIT-018/CROSS-017). Documented limitations: the Sites notify-me form screenshot is unreachable (requires a zero-slot day; all days have 10-36 slots) so the notify-me submission used the same public endpoint; queue positions were 5/6 instead of 1/2 because other groups' entries were already active; the matched slot was 19:00 (earliest in the window) rather than 19:30; B's quoted wait stayed at its 1-minute floor while its position decreased. Owned settings were restored (waitlist_max_parties NULL, waitlist_response_min 10, version 58), the browser session was closed, and leftover rows in my namespace (guest B waiting +15555551008, G10 Bravo +15555551003 from the cancelled attempt, two bookings by my test contacts on 2026-11-16) are listed for the next worker.
